summary: Repaired the bounded moving-frame aperture probe. It now uses an equal 0.25-second retained-speed window at 240/480 Hz, records native aperture pose/quaternion/linear and angular velocity plus observed joint angle and drive target at every physics sample, enables PhysX CCD, and limits its claim to sampled geometric crossing with a conservative inter-sample motion-margin tunneling control. Syntax validation passed; trusted-controller native GPU execution is still required. This does not claim exact rotational continuous collision detection, frozen bridge qualification, or full environment readiness.
